title: How to scan for unusual options activity

steps.text: This lesson shows how to find contracts trading far above their open interest.
All scan settings live in the filter panel on the left.
Set the minimum volume to open interest ratio. 2.0 means twice the usual activity.
Limit the scan to expiries in the next 30 days.
Matching contracts appear here, sorted by volume to open interest.
Click a row to load its price chart below.
Use the chart to check the move before you act on the signal.
